'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Mark Neumann LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Neumann]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Neumann]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will No Longer Meet|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
